concepts: A science-and-business programme combines entrepreneurship, strategy, finance and empirical research with renewable-energy systems and biomedical science. Biochemistry, pharmacology and disease mechanisms provide a life-science strand; energy-system design, life-cycle analysis and sustainability governance provide an energy strand. Mathematics, programming and data analysis support technical and commercial inquiry. It offers a substantive interdisciplinary response while lacking VU’s dedicated physics and organic-chemistry sequence, integrated innovation-project progression and compulsory research internship.

A concentrated energy-and-business programme studies renewable-energy design, material and resource flows, circular production, environmental information and sustainability governance alongside entrepreneurship, strategy, finance and research methods. Its additional environmental courses support decisions about resource supply, spatial impacts and cleaner production. It does not reproduce VU’s mechanics, electromagnetism, physics laboratory or complete innovation-project sequence.

A concentrated life-science-and-business programme studies biochemistry, cell biology, physiology, pharmacology, molecular pathology and biochemical laboratory methods alongside entrepreneurship, strategy, finance and qualitative and quantitative research. It connects biological knowledge and evidence to innovation decisions. It does not reproduce VU’s diagnostic imaging, dedicated organic-chemistry and physics sequence or compulsory individual research internship.
